what: Qnity makes the materials used to manufacture semiconductors and electronics: chemical mechanical planarisation slurries and pads, photoresists and specialty chemicals, and advanced packaging materials. It was separated from DuPont.
customers: Semiconductor manufacturers and foundries, advanced packaging houses and electronics manufacturers worldwide.
money: chemical mechanical planarisation, lithography and specialty materials
materials for printed circuit boards and advanced packaging
moat: Materials qualified into specific chip manufacturing processes, where changing supplier requires requalifying the whole production line.
risks: Debt of about $4.5 billion from the separation
Return on invested capital of about 6% reflects the separation's cost base
It is newly independent with a short record as a standalone company
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year with a 20% operating margin
Analysts see about 47% upside from current levels
Advanced packaging for AI chips uses far more of its materials per device
watch: Semiconductor Technologies revenue growth and advanced packaging material demand.
